payload.body: Yes: cc signs the meaning of ST0002/WP02's rule as built in src/which.rs (ca09eae..fdfe1e5). Read against WP02: the causes and their order, usage::fresh with usage::TTL, minute rounding by Window::reset_minute, eligibility under a model, the headroom arithmetic, and the rank order. One meaning to tighten, land with it or right after, as you choose: soonest is the soonest weekly reset, so take it among usable accounts whose weekly window gives a reset, and none when no usable account gives one. Today an undated account can come back as soonest, with no reset to name. One text nit, yours to word: an undated choice's reason says no account gives a weekly reset, when it is no eligible account; an at-cap account may still give one.
